Go alias menu uses its own callback root; TS kept alias removal outside the callback list

the old bot declares this root as a module-level const (const payloadAction = 'gcal' in callbacks/google.ts), and the TS extractor only reads the class-property form, so the checker reports the root as Go-only although both bots use the same gcal payloads

the checker compares command names, not descriptions: the old bot describes /archive as 'Архив расписания за прощедшие дни' (typo), the Go port spells it 'прошедшие'
the checker compares command names, not descriptions: the old bot describes /teacher as 'Узнать расписаниена день указанного преподавателя' (missing space), the Go port spells it correctly
the checker compares command names, not descriptions: the old bot stores the description of /comparegroups as an escaped unicode literal, the Go port keeps the same Russian text in plain characters

the checker compares command names, not descriptions: the old bot describes /restart as 'Перезапуск бота (только при использовании PM2)', the Go port works under systemd and Docker too and names the supervisor in the description
the old bot points at the VK API article (https://vk.com/@mgke_slave-api); the Go port links the documentation of its own repository instead

the old bot enforces adminOnly inside the command preHandle and answers nothing, so a user only sees the generic fallback; the Go port enforces the same rule in dispatchTextCommand and answers 'Команда не найдена'
the old bot answers /sql with the raw JSON of the driver result; the Go port prints a text table of the columns and rows
the old bot prints 'id: regexp' pairs from its command registry; Go commands expose a name and a text matcher instead of a pattern, so /regexp lists the sorted registered command names
the old bot prints plain numbered log lines; the Go port keeps the numbered log lines and appends the parser diagnostics (guards, missing selectors) of the last parse
the old bot prints the JSON of its Sequelize chat record; the Go port prints the chat struct with the names of its own fields
the old bot has /context, which dumps the raw grammy context object of the update; telego has no equivalent object to print, so the Go port has no such command

the old bot dumps Node.js figures (CPU temperature, load average, V8/OpenSSL versions, disk reads and writes) under the same section headers; the Go port keeps '-- Система --', '-- Бот --' and '-- База данных --' but reports the Go runtime counters instead and adds build information

the old bot answers a non-accepted chat a toast ('Чат не подтверждён, чтобы использовать это') for every callback and shows the access key only on commands; the Go port answers the same access message with the key for callbacks too, so a user without access always learns how to ask for it

the old bot's compact formatter overrides footer() to an empty string and therefore hides the parser-time line, the hints and the parser error warning; the Go port keeps the footer for every formatter, because hiding the warning would hide a real data problem

the Go port keeps the old wording verbatim where it is user visible (e.g. the /setTeacher success line) but fixes typos in command descriptions: 'прощедшие' -> 'прошедшие', 'расписаниена' -> 'расписание на'

the old /math evaluates the expression in a JavaScript VM, the Go port uses a Go expression parser: the visible messages match, but runtime error details differ (V8 adds 'Error:' style prefixes) and chained power 2^3^2 is right-associative in JS (512) while Go computes it left-associative (64); the old unreachable 'Выходящий тип данных почему-то не равен number' branch is not ported because the Go evaluator always returns a number

the old getGroup/getTeacher API methods answered 200 with {days: null} for an unknown name, the Go API answers 404 with an error body — the documented REST contract of the Go API, which apiprobe and API clients expect
the old getGroups/getTeachers returned a bare JSON array, the Go API wraps it as {"groups": [...]} / {"teachers": [...]} — documented Go contract; the sort order inside matches the old sort()
the old getGroup/getTeacher were POST methods with a query/body parameter, the Go API uses GET /api/group/:name and /api/teacher/:name — the documented Go REST route
the old sort() mapped numeric names to JSON numbers (a group '063' came back as 63), the Go API keeps every name a string so leading zeroes survive; only the ordering matches
GET /api/info additionally carries name, version and the build block next to the old groups/teachers/team/lastSuccess envelope

GET /api/parser-health carries the old ok/lastSuccessUpdate/groups/teachers shape plus a cache section with hit/miss counters; metrics.student/teacher stay null like on the old bot without the v2 parser
